name: camayoc_ex_stale_facts
description: Facts due for re-checking as of an instant: anything whose aegis:reviewAfter has passed. The staleness is computed at read time from a date written at write time; nothing stores the judgment 'stale'.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?entity ?label ?reviewAfter WHERE { ?entity aegis:reviewAfter ?reviewAfter ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(?reviewAfter < '{asof}') } ORDER BY ?reviewAfter ?label

params.name: asof
params.description: ISO-8601 date or instant to judge against
